From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:03-07:00
Subject: Interest in Redwood Inference - Marketplace listing

Hi Ben,

We found Redwood on the cloud marketplace and are evaluating options for serving several of our recommendation models with lower latency and predictable cost. I'm Priya (Platform Engineering at Acme Analytics). Would love a quick intro/demo to understand the product and pricing.

Primary questions:
- Do you support private VPC deployments and dedicated GPU capacity?
- Approx. latency we can expect for 8k context as inference across mixed workloads?
- Pricing model for Dedicated vs Hosted for steady 200 rps?

We signed up via the marketplace listing a few days ago and would like to schedule a 30-min intro/demo next week (PDT timezone). Any availability?

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Platform Engineering, Acme Analytics
priya.shah@acme-analytics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:26:10-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood Inference - Marketplace listing

Hi Priya — great to hear from you and welcome!

Thanks for signing up via the marketplace — I'd love to get you an intro and to loop in Camila (our AE) who handles architecture and deployment questions. Camila, Priya is evaluating serving and dedicated/private deployment options and is interested in a 30-min demo next week (PDT).

Priya — are any of these windows work for you? All times are PDT:
- Tue 4/20: 10:00am - 10:30am
- Tue 4/20: 2:00pm - 2:30pm
- Wed 4/21: 11:00am - 11:30am

If none work, tell us a couple of slots and we'll accommodate. Quick answers to your bullets in the meantime: we do support VPC/private deployments (Private) and Dedicated pools; latency varies by model & quantization but we can share benchmarks during the demo for 8k contexts. For steady 200 rps we typically recommend Reserved Dedicated with autoscaling (I can share ballpark pricing when Camila is on).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
